stories.headline: Tech Layoffs Passed All of 2025 With Four Months Left. The Companies Cutting Mostly Aren't Blaming AI.
stories.key_takeaway: 2026 layoffs have already exceeded last year's full-year total, but the firms doing the cutting cite span of control and cost resets, and the clearest AI signal is in entry-level hiring that never happens.

pull_quote.text: If you are laying people off without a mature, ready-to-go AI agent to do the work, you are not laying off people because of AI. You are laying people off for financial reasons and then imagining that at some future date, AI may be able to do the work.
